messages:
Anna: Heads-up — we got a customer report where quota/billing shows requests charged to the proxy service project instead of the original customer project when requests go through our edge-gateway. Example trace: request arrives with customer API key -> edge exchanges for a short-lived proxy key -> service backend only sees proxy key.

Ben: Oof. Do we have a minimal repro or logs? How often does it happen?

Anna: Repro steps and a tiny curl example below. Happens for any flow using the exchange path (not all customers) — looks like the gateway strips origin attribution.

```
# original client
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer SK_cust_ABC" https://edge/redwood/v1/predict

# edge exchange (internal)
X-Forwarded-For: 1.2.3.4
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer PK_proxy_XYZ" -H "X-RW-Origin-Id: cust-ABC" https://svc.private/internal
```

Anna: Proposal: add a minimal, non-sensitive origin header on the post-exchange request (x-rw-origin-id) or a short HMAC'd token that the backend can use to attribute quota/billing and emit telemetry. Also add a counter metric auth.origin_proxy.misattribution and a dashboard panel that surfaces top proxies by count.

Olga: Security question — are we comfortable with passing the raw customer key id in headers? That could be used by logs/3rd party infra. If we do this, prefer a derived id (sha256(key_id)[:12]) or a signed subject token that contains only what we need. Also need an audit of retention policy for that header.

Kevin: Implementation note: our current request flow validates the proxy token then does quota charging. If we want correct attribution we either need to: (a) resolve origin before charge (slightly more work), or (b) keep current order but make the gateway emit attribution events into our billing pipeline. Swapping order has perf impacts.

Ben: For telemetry naming — I like: `auth.origin_proxy.misattribution.count` (counter), `auth.origin_proxy.sampled_trace` (hist with sample label), and `auth.origin_proxy.enabled_by_org` (gauge tag). Dashboard should show timeseries for misattrib + top-10 proxies, and a table of example traces (link to trace ids).

telemetry-bot: CI check: rule "metric-name-conventions" passed for proposed metrics. See: https://ci.internal/metrics/runs/8921

Olga: Rollout/UX suggestion: expose this as console toggle per-org "Preserve proxied origin for billing" with clear note about what is sent to our logs. Default = off. Beta in 1% of orgs first. We'll need an audit event every time origin header is accepted.

Anna: Agreed on opt-in. Action items: I'll open RFC (PR + design doc) to propose HMAC token approach + header schema. @Ben can wire metric and add dashboard tile. @Olga can draft security memo and hashing guidance. @Kevin can prototype pre-attribution flow vs gateway-attribution events and measure latency delta.

Kevin: Sounds good. Quick question on backward compat: if older services ignore the header, nothing breaks (we just won't attribute). Good to call out in RFC.

Anna: Yup — RFC will include fallback behavior and migration notes. Setting the initial rollout to beta + 1% sampling and telemetry to count misattrib and sampling traces should give enough signal before wider enable.

Ben: I'll create the dashboard skeleton and add an alert rule: if misattrib.rate > 0.5% of auth traffic for more than 10m, page eng-platform.

Olga: I'll run the privacy review and propose the minimal derived id scheme.

Anna: Thanks team — I'll drop the RFC link here when ready and cc billing/sales so they're aware. :thumbsup:
